content.title: Graphic Course | Gate, Obstacles and Solo Finish
content.summary: A single color-locked lead travels through a graphic environment that behaves as a course: oversized planar signs, directional graphic gates, spatial reset, denser multi-object obstacle interval and solo final poster. Preserve progressive route and graphic-to-spatial coupling, not the source typography, outfit or violence.

quick_start.input_format: Identify one lead with a persistent silhouette/accent color before moving through the oversized graphic course. + Make two or more graphic structures function as traversable space and use one circular gate as a visible transition. + After a short identity reset, raise density with multiple obstacles and then isolate the lead in a held final frame.
quick_start.recommended_input: An adult urban wayfinding courier in cobalt workwear carries a glowing parcel through an original geometric exhibition course. Scale-changing floor stripes and a neutral circle gate lead through connected corridors. She walks around a slow side-closing padded barrier, then crouches under a raised foam beam whose lower edge stays safely above her crouched height. Without collision she places the parcel on a lit pedestal and stands alone in a clean final display frame.
required_anchors: 图形成为真实可走结构
终点结果与单人姿态稳定
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: A single color-locked lead travels through a graphic environment that behaves as a course: oversized planar signs, directional graphic gates, spatial reset, denser multi-object obstacle interval and solo final poster. Preserve progressive route and graphic-to-spatial coupling, not the source typography, outfit or violence.

invariants.rule: Identify one lead with a persistent silhouette/accent color before moving through the oversized graphic course.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without one stable lead, rapid zones seem unrelated.

invariants.rule: Make two or more graphic structures function as traversable space and use one circular gate as a visible transition.
invariants.purpose: Gives the course a specific graphic-motion grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: If graphics remain mere overlays, travel lacks environmental stakes.

invariants.rule: After a short identity reset, raise density with multiple obstacles and then isolate the lead in a held final frame.
invariants.purpose: Provides escalation and decisive visual closure.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without reset and isolation, the climax becomes uninterrupted action noise.

slots.name: accent_color
slots.constraint: Single stable subject accent distinct from source red.

slots.name: obstacles
slots.constraint: Readable multi-object challenge, no injury required.

slots.name: final_display
slots.constraint: Solo stable end frame with no copied wordmark.

anti_copy_exclusions: No source title, wordmark, exact English letterform walls or typography layout.
No source character face, hair, red trousers, fight poses or opponent designs.
Do not imply original source sound or precise portal lore was verified.
